summary: Per-state Lucide icons on folder rows, live run progress bar, pending-changes menu gating, and a keyring/auth state fix.
changelog: Folder rows show a Lucide glyph and tint per state instead of the old generic icons (issue #94).
Row status icons are sized at 22 px so they no longer look like empty circles.
The 'Synced in local' subtitle only appears while the folder is actually synchronized.
A slim green run-progress bar pulses under a folder row while it is syncing (issue #90).
The folder-row menu offers 'Pending changes…' only when a scan has found pending items (issue #92).
A locked password keyring is reported as such and retried, instead of being misread as missing credentials and showing 'Account Needs Attention' on every account (issue #98).
